title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

overview_visual.alt_text: Two-column lesson roadmap for Module 1: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence. It lists 8 curriculum topics and ends with the workflow Observe, Experiment, Evaluate, Iterate.
overview_visual.caption: Module 1 visual roadmap: scan the ordered lesson cards, then use the Observe → Experiment → Evaluate → Iterate cycle when applying the concepts.

notes: All 8 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. AI literacy begins with the task and the people affected by it. Treat an AI output as a proposal to inspect, not as automatic proof. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
